summary: A centered heading whose key words each carry the icon that names them: a pen for written, a camera for filmed, a microphone for recorded.

props.name: size
props.description: Text size of the whole heading; the icons scale with it.

props.name: animated
props.description: The icons pop in one after another as the heading first renders. Turn it off for a heading that is simply there, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.
